title: 天为什么是蓝的
subtitle: 阳光里藏着七种颜色
character: wearing a sky blue t-shirt, khaki shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft chalk pastel on textured paper, gentle gradients of sky blue, warm orange and cream, simple rounded shapes, soft grain

pages.zh:
我躺在草地上看天。
天蓝蓝的，
一直蓝到很远很远的地方。
我问爸爸：
天为什么是蓝的呢？
pages.scene: The little boy lies on his back on green grass with his hands behind his head, looking up at a wide blue sky.

pages.zh:
先说太阳光。
它看起来是白的，
其实里面藏着七种颜色，
红、橙、黄、绿、
蓝、靛、紫，都在里面。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one beam of white light entering a triangular glass prism on a cream background and coming out the other side as seven coloured stripes. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
空气里有很多很小的分子，
小到看不见。
阳光穿过空气的时候，
会撞到它们，
被撞得到处乱跑。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one straight ray arriving from the left on a pale background and hitting a small round particle, then scattering into several short rays going in different directions. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这种被撞得乱跑，
叫做「散射」。
有意思的是：
蓝光被撞得最厉害，
红光几乎直直地穿过去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two rays on a pale background: a blue ray hitting a particle and scattering into many directions, and a red ray passing the same particle almost straight through. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以抬头看天的时候，
从四面八方
跑进我们眼睛的，
大多是被撞散的蓝光。
天就看起来是蓝的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one eye at the bottom of a pale blue background with many short blue rays arriving at it from all directions above. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
那太阳自己呢？
因为直直穿过来的
大多是黄光和红光，
所以我们看太阳，
是黄黄的、暖暖的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one yellow sun on a pale blue background with straight yellow rays going directly downward from it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
傍晚的时候，
太阳低低的，
阳光要斜着穿过很厚的空气。
蓝光在路上就被撞光了，
剩下的红光跑到我们眼睛里。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one low sun at the left of a cream background with a long slanted ray passing through a thick band of air before reaching an eye at the right. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以早晨和傍晚的天，
会变成橙色和红色。
路越长，
剩下的颜色就越红。
pages.scene: One sunset sky on textured paper with bands of orange, pink and deep red above a simple dark horizon line. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
云为什么是白的呢？
因为云里的小水珠
比空气分子大得多，
它把七种颜色
差不多同样地撞散，合起来就是白。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one white cloud on a pale blue background with a white ray entering it and several white rays leaving it in different directions. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
月亮上没有空气，
没有东西撞散阳光。
所以站在月亮上看，
天空是黑的，
就算太阳正照着也一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one grey moon surface along the bottom of a black background with a bright sun above it and stars still visible around the sun. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
海水看起来是蓝的，
一半是因为它反射了天空，
一半是因为水本身
就会把红光吃掉一点，
把蓝光留下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one cross-section of sea water on a pale background with a red ray fading out as it goes deeper and a blue ray continuing further down. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
傍晚，我又躺在草地上。
天从蓝色，
一点一点变成橙色。
我知道了：
那是阳光走的路变长了。
pages.scene: The little boy lies on the grass at sunset, hands behind his head, the sky above him shading from blue at the top to orange near the horizon.
